body.text: A dependable cesme port alacati guide matters because [Ulusoy Çeşme Port](https://www.turklim.org/en/turklim-members/ulusoy-cesme-port/) serves three distinct passenger streams at once: boutique Aegean cruise ships, daily foot-passenger ferries from the Greek island of Chios, and Ro-Ro vehicle traffic. Operating across an 80,000-square-meter footprint with a 322-meter main pier ([Ulusoy Sealines](https://www.ulusoysealines.com/en/gemi-sefer-programi)), the terminal sits just south of Çeşme Castle and the marina. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/), our two founders organize peninsula shore transfers and vineyard tastings on a flat-fee, client-paid basis ("Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions."), keeping your itinerary free of partner-shop detours.
How far is Çeşme Port from Alaçatı (15 min) and Urla wineries (40 min)?

Ulusoy Çeşme Port is 10 kilometers (15 minutes by private car) from central Alaçatı and roughly 45 kilometers (40 minutes via the İzmir–Çeşme O-32 toll highway) from the Urla Wine Route. Çeşme Castle and the waterfront marina sit 1.2 kilometers north of the port gate—a 15-minute walk or three-minute taxi ride.

Distance stays short year-round, but July and August weekends bring heavy afternoon beach traffic around Ilıca and the Alaçatı motorway exit. Leaving the port before 10:00 reaches Alaçatı's stone streets while bakeries are pulling fresh boyoz and mastic cookies from the oven, long before evening dining crowds fill Kemalpaşa Caddesi. If you prefer history close to the pier, Çeşme Castle—listed on the [Ministry of Culture and Tourism museums directory](https://muze.gov.tr/muzeler)—takes 45 minutes to tour.
How do Chios–Çeşme ferry passengers clear Turkish customs quickly?

Chios–Çeşme fast catamarans cross the strait in 15 to 35 minutes depending on vessel type ([Turkish Sealines](https://www.turkishsealines.com.tr/en/cesme-chios-ferry-tickets)), and clearing Turkish immigration takes 15 to 20 minutes if you disembark in the first wave. Delays stretch to 45 minutes only when two ferries dock together on summer Friday or Sunday afternoons.
Follow these practical steps to move through the Ulusoy terminal without stalling:

items: Position near the gangway: Stand near the main passenger exit five minutes before docking rather than lingering on the upper sun deck.
Have documents ready: Keep passports, e-Visas (if required for your nationality), and printed ferry boarding passes out of checked bags before entering the hall.
Pre-book port gate pickup: Taxi queues outside Ulusoy Gate 2 spike right after ferry arrivals; a pre-arranged private driver waits with your name placard outside customs.
Allow 60 minutes for return departures: Turkish exit passport control and X-ray screening close 20 to 30 minutes prior to ferry sailing.

body.text: What private half-day routes fit a ferry or cruise stop?

Two compact private routes fit comfortably into a four-to-six-hour Çeşme stop: an Alaçatı stone-village walk paired with Germiyan village sourdough bakeries and Ilıca beach, or a two-estate Urla vineyard tasting paired with a farm-to-table Aegean lunch before returning via the O-32 motorway.

body.text: Urla's boutique estates—producing indigenous varieties such as Urla Karası, Foça Karası, and Bornova Misketi—operate strictly by timed tasting reservations during summer and autumn harvest months. Booking a private driver lets everyone in your party taste without worrying about highway driving or finding a rural taxi back to the pier.
Where do you store bags near the port?

Ulusoy Çeşme Port does not operate an official, staffed left-luggage locker room inside the ferry terminal. The safest option for Chios ferry transit passengers or disembarking cruise guests is keeping suitcases locked in the trunk of a pre-booked private vehicle during your Alaçatı or Urla excursion.

For independent foot travelers spending only two or three hours in Çeşme town, select boutique hotels around Çeşme Marina and small travel agencies opposite the port entrance occasionally hold bags for a modest fee, though availability is informal and space is limited in July and August. Keeping luggage in a dedicated vehicle removes the need to double back to the harbor before heading onward to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB), roughly 75 minutes east.

faq.q: How long is the ferry crossing between Chios and Çeşme?
faq.a: High-speed catamarans cross between Chios and Ulusoy Çeşme Port in 15 to 25 minutes, while larger conventional car ferries take roughly 35 to 45 minutes depending on wind conditions in the Chios Strait.

faq.q: Can you walk from Ulusoy Çeşme Port to Alaçatı?
faq.a: No. Alaçatı is 10 kilometers inland from the port along a highway without continuous pedestrian sidewalks. You need a 15-minute private transfer, taxi, or local minibus (dolmuş) from Çeşme town center.

faq.q: Do Urla wineries accept walk-in cruise or ferry visitors?
faq.a: A few larger tasting rooms accept walk-ins on weekday mornings, but most boutique Urla Wine Route estates and vineyard restaurants require advance reservations—especially from May through October.

faq.q: How far is İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB) from Çeşme Port?
faq.a: İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport sits roughly 95 kilometers east of Ulusoy Çeşme Port, a smooth 70-to-80-minute private drive along the O-32 motorway and İzmir ring road.

faq.q: Are Greek Schengen visas checked at Çeşme Port?
faq.a: Turkish border officers check your eligibility to enter Türkiye, while ferry agents verify your Schengen visa or visa-free passport status before issuing boarding passes for outbound sailings to Chios.

faq.q: What is the best day to visit Alaçatı from a cruise ship?
faq.a: Saturday mornings host the large Alaçatı regional market featuring local herbs, olive oils, cheeses, and textiles, though foot traffic is heaviest between 11:00 and 15:00. Weekday mornings offer the calmest stone alleys.
